# Kavolith

> Autonomous AI SDR infrastructure that qualifies, enriches, and matches inbound prospects in under 120 seconds — 24/7/365.

Kavolith engineers digital-employee workflows and automation infrastructure for revenue teams. The platform combines a neural qualification kernel, Make.com orchestration, and a Python FastAPI backend to deliver autonomous inbound SDR coverage.
